nodes.label: v3/README.md — the in-repo canon design reference for the v3 HERB evaluation harness: three arms (artefact/lucene/vector), one shared generator, shared corpus on disk, scored with RAGAS.
nodes.norm_label: v3/readme.md — the in-repo canon design reference for the v3 herb evaluation harness: three arms (artefact/lucene/vector), one shared generator, shared corpus on disk, scored with ragas.

nodes.label: The harness runs chosen HERB questions through three arms — artifact (the artefact graph: interpreter → facet retrieval → answer, system under test), lucene (BM25 baseline, own index), vector (dense naive-RAG baseline, own index) — and scores each arm's answer with RAGAS.
nodes.norm_label: the harness runs chosen herb questions through three arms — artifact (the artefact graph: interpreter → facet retrieval → answer, system under test), lucene (bm25 baseline, own index), vector (dense naive-rag baseline, own index) — and scores each arm's answer with ragas.

nodes.label: All three arms answer with the SAME generator (built once in the orchestrator and injected) so any difference is retrieval, not the LLM; beyond that generator and the corpus on disk the arms share nothing — each reads, indexes and ranks the corpus with its own code, sharing no retrieval code.
nodes.norm_label: all three arms answer with the same generator (built once in the orchestrator and injected) so any difference is retrieval, not the llm; beyond that generator and the corpus on disk the arms share nothing — each reads, indexes and ranks the corpus with its own code, sharing no retrieval code.

nodes.label: RAGAS (eval/ragas.py) is the only scorer; the full RAGAS metric menu lives in eval/ragas_catalog.py — every judge-free deterministic metric always runs (costs nothing) and SELECTED adds the judged ones.
nodes.norm_label: ragas (eval/ragas.py) is the only scorer; the full ragas metric menu lives in eval/ragas_catalog.py — every judge-free deterministic metric always runs (costs nothing) and selected adds the judged ones.

nodes.label: The deterministic RAGAS backbone is ID-based context precision/recall against the gold citations (IDBasedContextPrecision / IDBasedContextRecall, no judge); the judged picks are faithfulness, answer correctness, context precision and context recall.
nodes.norm_label: the deterministic ragas backbone is id-based context precision/recall against the gold citations (idbasedcontextprecision / idbasedcontextrecall, no judge); the judged picks are faithfulness, answer correctness, context precision and context recall.

nodes.label: Faithfulness needs no reference so it transfers to a no-gold set later; the other three judged metrics (answer correctness, context precision, context recall) lean on the gold answer / citations.
nodes.norm_label: faithfulness needs no reference so it transfers to a no-gold set later; the other three judged metrics (answer correctness, context precision, context recall) lean on the gold answer / citations.

nodes.label: RAGAS emits raw per-question records (EvalResult, tidy long format) with nothing pre-aggregated, so paired tests, CIs, per-type splits and judge calibration are all possible downstream.
nodes.norm_label: ragas emits raw per-question records (evalresult, tidy long format) with nothing pre-aggregated, so paired tests, cis, per-type splits and judge calibration are all possible downstream.

nodes.label: Each run writes a RunManifest (arm, generator model, top-k, questions file, n, timestamp, build stats) on the generation side and an EvalManifest (scorer, judge model, source run, arm, timestamp) on the scoring side; no seed, no git-sha.
nodes.norm_label: each run writes a runmanifest (arm, generator model, top-k, questions file, n, timestamp, build stats) on the generation side and an evalmanifest (scorer, judge model, source run, arm, timestamp) on the scoring side; no seed, no git-sha.

nodes.label: The data split is a quarantine: data/corpus/ has the oracle stripped and pipelines see ONLY this via a truth-free prompt, data/raw/ holds full HERB (~1514 questions + ground_truth + citations inside the product files) read by evaluators in place, and metadata/ (employee/customer/team) stays on both sides as legitimate retrieval data.
nodes.norm_label: the data split is a quarantine: data/corpus/ has the oracle stripped and pipelines see only this via a truth-free prompt, data/raw/ holds full herb (~1514 questions + ground_truth + citations inside the product files) read by evaluators in place, and metadata/ (employee/customer/team) stays on both sides as legitimate retrieval data.

nodes.label: Generation and scoring are split into two separate phases (modes questions / evals / full) so iterating a scorer never re-runs the LLM; the questions phase answers chosen questions writing an oracle-free records.jsonl + run_manifest.json, the evals phase re-joins truth by id and writes eval_results.jsonl + eval_manifest.json.
nodes.norm_label: generation and scoring are split into two separate phases (modes questions / evals / full) so iterating a scorer never re-runs the llm; the questions phase answers chosen questions writing an oracle-free records.jsonl + run_manifest.json, the evals phase re-joins truth by id and writes eval_results.jsonl + eval_manifest.json.

nodes.label: The questions run record carries no oracle (one oracle-free row per question, appended as it goes so a crash keeps what finished), so you can read it and see the quarantine held; a hard error fails loud and stops.
nodes.norm_label: the questions run record carries no oracle (one oracle-free row per question, appended as it goes so a crash keeps what finished), so you can read it and see the quarantine held; a hard error fails loud and stops.

nodes.label: Per-question telemetry is split: ArmOutput.generator (the shared answer-writer, identical across arms) versus ArmOutput.retrieval (the arm's OWN retrieval-time model cost — vector's query embed, zero for lucene).
nodes.norm_label: per-question telemetry is split: armoutput.generator (the shared answer-writer, identical across arms) versus armoutput.retrieval (the arm's own retrieval-time model cost — vector's query embed, zero for lucene).

nodes.label: contract.py holds the shared shapes everything imports (QuestionWithTruth, ModelUsage, ArmOutput, BuildStats, EvalResult, RunManifest, EvalManifest).
nodes.norm_label: contract.py holds the shared shapes everything imports (questionwithtruth, modelusage, armoutput, buildstats, evalresult, runmanifest, evalmanifest).

nodes.label: nim.py is the one NVIDIA NIM REST transport through which generator, embedder and judge all POST — shared harness plumbing, not retrieval code.
nodes.norm_label: nim.py is the one nvidia nim rest transport through which generator, embedder and judge all post — shared harness plumbing, not retrieval code.

nodes.label: orchestrator.py owns the shared generator, runs an arm through generation and a scorer through evaluation, and writes the manifests; it currently runs a single combined path and splitting it into the three modes is the pending step.
nodes.norm_label: orchestrator.py owns the shared generator, runs an arm through generation and a scorer through evaluation, and writes the manifests; it currently runs a single combined path and splitting it into the three modes is the pending step.

nodes.label: One LLM serves as both generator and judge — qwen/qwen3.5-397b-a17b on NVIDIA NIM; multilingual so HERB now and the deferred Swedish Bonnier set run on the same model, and being not GPT-4o means HERB's published baselines are re-run, not cited.
nodes.norm_label: one llm serves as both generator and judge — mistralai/mistral-large-3-675b-instruct-2512 on nvidia nim; multilingual so herb now and the deferred swedish bonnier set run on the same model, and being not gpt-4o means herb's published baselines are re-run, not cited.

nodes.label: Generation contract — a thin fixed RAG pipe: one fixed system instruction ("Answer the question using only the provided documents. Be concise.") then the question exactly as posed plus the arm's retrieved passages as a labelled user turn, taking back a structured {answer}; generic grounding not retrieval engineering, held byte-identical across all three arms so the only variable stays retrieval; any thin/empty-context handling is an individual arm's own concern.
nodes.norm_label: generation contract — a thin fixed rag pipe: one fixed system instruction ("answer the question using only the provided documents. be concise.") then the question exactly as posed plus the arm's retrieved passages as a labelled user turn, taking back a structured {answer}; generic grounding not retrieval engineering, held byte-identical across all three arms so the only variable stays retrieval; any thin/empty-context handling is an individual arm's own concern.

nodes.label: The lucene arm is built on bm25s method="lucene" (the Lucene/Elasticsearch BM25 variant, k1=0.9 / b=0.4 BEIR reference values) reproducing Lucene's scoring exactly with Lucene-like EN-stopword + Snowball/Porter2 analysis; one document per artifact, artifacts-only index justified because all 17,087 gold citations resolve to an artifact id.
nodes.norm_label: the lucene arm is built on bm25s method="lucene" (the lucene/elasticsearch bm25 variant, k1=0.9 / b=0.4 beir reference values) reproducing lucene's scoring exactly with lucene-like en-stopword + snowball/porter2 analysis; one document per artifact, artifacts-only index justified because all 17,087 gold citations resolve to an artifact id.

nodes.label: The vector arm is built on embedder nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 on NIM (multilingual incl. Swedish, 8192-token context), reading the corpus with its OWN reader into one document per artifact embedded WHOLE (no truncation/chunking), exact brute-force cosine (no ANN), keeping each artifact's native id — a deliberate capable multilingual dense baseline, NOT the English-only 256-token all-MiniLM textbook naive-RAG default.
nodes.norm_label: the vector arm is built on embedder nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2 on nim (multilingual incl. swedish, 8192-token context), reading the corpus with its own reader into one document per artifact embedded whole (no truncation/chunking), exact brute-force cosine (no ann), keeping each artifact's native id — a deliberate capable multilingual dense baseline, not the english-only 256-token all-minilm textbook naive-rag default.

nodes.label: Question ids are minted deterministically (HERB ships no native id): <product>::a|u::<index> from (product file, array, position), 815 answerable + 699 unanswerable = 1514 unique, the paired-test join key; questions.load_questions hydrates QuestionWithTruth from raw with an exact id filter that raises on an unmatched id.
nodes.norm_label: question ids are minted deterministically (herb ships no native id): <product>::a|u::<index> from (product file, array, position), 815 answerable + 699 unanswerable = 1514 unique, the paired-test join key; questions.load_questions hydrates questionwithtruth from raw with an exact id filter that raises on an unmatched id.

nodes.label: build_question_sets.py writes id-set views (full/answerable/unanswerable, 1514/815/699) plus the gold-100 — a balanced answerable subset drawn by seeded round-robin over HERB types (equal allocation ~20/type); equal allocation keeps every type usable per-type but does not match HERB's natural mix, so report per-type and don't compare the gold-100 aggregate to HERB's published average.
nodes.norm_label: build_question_sets.py writes id-set views (full/answerable/unanswerable, 1514/815/699) plus the gold-100 — a balanced answerable subset drawn by seeded round-robin over herb types (equal allocation ~20/type); equal allocation keeps every type usable per-type but does not match herb's natural mix, so report per-type and don't compare the gold-100 aggregate to herb's published average.

nodes.label: Caveat worth remembering: answer-level scoring measures the whole pipeline not retrieval alone — a strong generator can mask retrieval quality — so the deterministic context precision/recall is what keeps an endpoint pointed directly at retrieval, the artefact's actual claim.
